name: Mauritania
summary: A green field with a gold crescent and star, and red stripes along the top and bottom edges. The red stripes were added in 2017 to honour those who fought for independence.
origin: Mauritania adopted a green flag with a gold crescent and star on 1 April 1959, before independence from France in 1960.
In a 2017 constitutional referendum, voters approved adding red stripes, introduced on 15 August 2017. The referendum was boycotted by much of the opposition.

colors.name: Red
colors.meaning: The blood shed by those who fought for independence.

symbols.name: Crescent and star
symbols.description: A gold crescent opening upward, with a gold star above it.

facts: Its crescent opens upward, unlike most crescents on national flags.
The 2017 referendum also abolished the Senate.
Mauritania is one of the few countries with 'Islamic Republic' in its official name.
clues: Green with a gold upward-facing crescent and star, and red stripes at top and bottom.
Its red stripes were added after a 2017 referendum.
